name: NavMeshConnection
signature: public readonly struct NavMeshConnection(Float3 start, Float3 end, float radius, int area, bool bidirectional, int linkId)

docs.summary: An off-mesh connection an agent can actually traverse, at the endpoints Detour snapped onto walkable polygons rather than where the [`NavMeshLink`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshLink) asked for. A link that reached nothing walkable is absent here, which is the only way to tell it failed.
Endpoint radius: half the width the link was built with.
Area index (see [`NavMeshAreas`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAreas)), which is also what it costs.
The [`LinkId`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshLink~LinkId) stamped at bake, or 0 for a connection that came from somewhere else.
